keyPoints: Samantar shreni (AP) me har pad pichhle me niyat antar d jodne par milta hai — 3, 7, 11, 15 me d = 4.
nvaan pad: a_n = a + (n-1)d — 10vaan pad = a + 9d.
Pehle n padon ka yog: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n-1)d] = n/2 (pehla + aakhiri pad).
Agar teen sankhyaen AP me hon to beech wali dono ka ausat hoti hai — a - d, a, a + d maanna aasaan rehta hai — chaar sankhyaen hon to a-3d, a-d, a+d, a+3d lo.
S_n se a_n nikalo: a_n = S_n - S_(n-1) — yog diya ho to pad mil jaata hai.
Rozmarra me: seedhiyon ki lambai, bachat ki kist, khet ki med — har jagah AP — niyat antar wali har suchi AP hai.
Aam galti: nvaan pad ke sutra me (n-1) ki jagah n se guna karna — pehla pad a + 0d hai, isliye (n-1)d lagta hai.
